name: Bowling
shortDescription: Boutique-style bowling at Generations AdventurePlex.
details: Up to 6 bowlers per lane. One-hour, half-hour, and per-game options are offered. Walk-ins are welcome based on availability; reservations are accepted and encouraged.
priceText: $30/lane Tue-Thu or $40/lane Fri-Sun for 1 hour; $17.50/$25 for 30 min; $6/$8 per person by game; shoes $4 + tax.
customerFacingNotes: Capacity is 6 bowlers per lane; spectators do not count. Same-day reservations are handled by phone.
salesNotes: For parties/groups over 6, multiple lanes are needed. Groups of 20+ should move toward a custom group-event inquiry.

name: Axe Throwing
shortDescription: Coach-guided axe throwing in the Axe Den.
details: One-hour and 30-minute sessions. A trained axe coach is included. Close-toed shoes and a signed waiver are required.
customerFacingNotes: Current axe-specific pages state participants must be 16+. Guests under 18 need a parent/legal guardian to sign the waiver. Close-toed shoes required.
salesNotes: Ask ages before recommending. Same-day reservations are by phone.

name: Mobile Axe Throwing
shortDescription: Two-lane mobile axe throwing rental for off-site events.
details: Includes setup, breakdown, transport, and an axe coach.
priceText: $650 for 2 hours; $250/additional hour; $2/mile outside a 5-mile radius.
customerFacingNotes: Off-site mobile axe throwing option for larger events.
salesNotes: Confirm service area and logistics with staff.

name: Laser Tag
shortDescription: Multi-level laser tag arena experience.
details: Single-game play plus a Thursday unlimited special.
customerFacingNotes: Walk-in attraction.
salesNotes: Strong fit for birthdays, youth groups, sports teams, and mixed-age events.

name: Grizzly Falls Mini Golf
shortDescription: Seasonal mini golf attraction.
details: Seasonal mini golf at AdventurePlex.
customerFacingNotes: Open seasonally.
salesNotes: Ask season/date before recommending as guaranteed.

name: Arcade
shortDescription: Large arcade using reloadable PlayCards.
details: Arcade pricing varies by game. PlayCards are purchased/reloaded and used for arcade play.
customerFacingNotes: Walk-in play.
salesNotes: Good event add-on; birthday packages include specific PlayCard values.

name: Climbing Walls
shortDescription: Multi-sided climbing wall challenge.
details: Walk-in climbing attraction.
customerFacingNotes: Walk-in only.
salesNotes: Included in the Have It All birthday package unlimited-play portion.

name: Corn Hole
shortDescription: Indoor cornhole rounds.
details: All-ages indoor cornhole.
customerFacingNotes: Walk-in play.
salesNotes: Useful casual add-on for family, group, and adult events.

name: Go-Kart Racing
shortDescription: Junior indoor electric go-kart racing and family racing activities at Generations Raceway.
details: Indoor electric racing in a climate-controlled environment for kids and families. Website highlights ages 8 and up.
customerFacingNotes: Ages 8+. Race times often sell out; advance reservation is recommended and walk-in availability is not guaranteed.
salesNotes: Included in this same tenant for development; keep Raceway distinct as a location label.

name: Putt Mania
shortDescription: Technology-infused mini golf activity for kids and families, with digital scoring and gamified challenges.
details: Interactive mini golf activities for kids, families, corporate outings, networking events, birthdays, and team building.
customerFacingNotes: Advance tee-time reservation recommended; walk-in availability is not guaranteed.
salesNotes: Differentiate from Grizzly Falls: Putt Mania is the Raceway digital mini golf attraction.

name: Game Zone Arcade
shortDescription: Arcade activities at Generations Raceway with 30+ games for kids and families.
details: Game Zone arcade activities with more than 30 games for kids and families.
customerFacingNotes: Some Raceway packages include PlayCard value.
salesNotes: Keep distinct from the AdventurePlex Arcade for future location-aware catalog.

name: Have a Ball Birthday Package
shortDescription: Birthday package with bowling or mini golf plus arcade credits.
details: 1 game of mini golf for all guests OR 1 hour bowling; $15 PlayCard per guest; $20 PlayCard for birthday VIP.
priceText: $275.99 up to 10 guests; $27.99 each additional guest.
customerFacingNotes: Same-day party booking should be handled by phone.
salesNotes: Recommend for a simpler birthday centered on bowling/mini golf plus arcade.

name: Have a Blast Birthday Package
shortDescription: Birthday package centered on unlimited laser tag.
details: 90 minutes unlimited laser tag; $10 PlayCard per guest; $15 PlayCard for birthday VIP.
priceText: $349.99 up to 10 guests; $34.99 each additional guest.
customerFacingNotes: Birthday package.
salesNotes: Recommend for laser-tag-focused birthdays.

name: Have It All Birthday Package
shortDescription: Birthday package combining bowling, laser tag, climbing, and arcade.
details: 30 minutes bowling; 90 minutes unlimited laser tag and wall climbing; $15 PlayCard per guest; $20 PlayCard for birthday VIP.
priceText: $429.99 up to 10 guests; $42.99 each additional guest.
customerFacingNotes: Broadest current AdventurePlex birthday package mix.
salesNotes: Recommend when customers want variety and multiple attractions.

name: Victory Lane Birthday Party
shortDescription: Raceway birthday package with racing, arcade credit, and private party room.
details: One go-kart race per guest, $20 Arcade PlayCard per guest, 2 hours in Pit Stop Party Room, table coverings, dessert plates/forks, birthday racer T-shirt.
customerFacingNotes: Minimum 8 participating guests.
salesNotes: Ask ages because go-kart racing is listed 8+.

name: Raceway Company Team Building Package
shortDescription: Raceway group/corporate package.
details: One go-kart race, one Putt Mania round, $10 Arcade PlayCard, presentation amenities, 2-hour private room rental.
customerFacingNotes: Website lists up to 20 guests.
salesNotes: Recommend for corporate outings/networking/team building.

name: Custom Group & Corporate Event
shortDescription: Custom-built AdventurePlex event for groups, companies, teams, and special occasions.
details: Can combine attractions, food/beverage, private room, and adult beverage experiences.
customerFacingNotes: Groups of 20+ should use the event inquiry path or contact the events team.
salesNotes: Qualify date/time, guest count, age mix, attractions, food/beverage, private room, budget, special requests; handoff for live availability/custom quote.

name: Sports Team Event
shortDescription: Custom sports-team event built around activities, food, drinks, and budget.
details: AdventurePlex markets custom packages for sports teams with activities plus optional food and drinks.
customerFacingNotes: Packages are customized to the team and budget.
salesNotes: Ask team size, ages, budget, attractions, food/beverage, room needs, date/time.

name: Play Therapy Team Building
shortDescription: Facilitated weekday team-building experience using structured play.
details: Available weekdays 9am-4pm. Activities may include bowling, axe throwing, mini golf, laser tag, arcade challenges, facilitator, and awards/certificates.
customerFacingNotes: Reservations required; website directs customers to call 574-855-1095.
salesNotes: Best for company culture/team connection; ask attendee count, date/time, company, activities and food interest.

name: Holiday Party / Company Holiday Event
shortDescription: Custom holiday celebrations, company parties, and New Year events.
details: Can use bowling, arcade, axe throwing, laser tag, climbing, food and drinks.
customerFacingNotes: Custom planning available for private gatherings and company holiday celebrations.
salesNotes: Ask business name, date/time, guest count, food/beverage, private room, craft beverage interest, special requests.

name: Wedding Reception / Wedding Event
shortDescription: Entertainment-focused wedding reception/event experience.
details: Can include axe throwing, Grizzly Falls mini golf, arcade, laser tag, bowling, climbing walls, and cornhole.
customerFacingNotes: Customized wedding reception/event planning is available.
salesNotes: Treat as custom event; gather date, guest count, food/beverage, room, attraction mix, special requests.

name: Graduation / Summer Celebration
shortDescription: Graduation package with private room, attraction, arcade credit, and specialty food option.
details: 3 hours in Skybox private event room with linen/tables/chairs; choice of 1 hour bowling with shoes OR 1 hour axe throwing per guest; $20 PlayCard per guest; Backyard BBQ or Grilled Fajita Bar option.
priceText: Price not published; contact events team.
customerFacingNotes: Axe eligibility/waiver rules apply if chosen.
salesNotes: Do not invent price; ask ages if axe throwing is considered.

name: Custom Event / Party
shortDescription: Flexible event-building path for unique or special requests.
details: Attraction choices, food/beverage, private rooms, beer-wall interest, budget and special-request planning.
customerFacingNotes: A team member finalizes custom event and availability.
salesNotes: Use when fixed packages do not fit; gather date/time, guest count, ages, attractions, food, room, budget, special requests.

name: Fundraiser - Take It Up
shortDescription: Climbing Wall Challenge fundraiser.
details: Supporters climb and the organization earns money back per paid climb.
priceText: $5 per climb; organization earns $2 back per climber.
customerFacingNotes: Registration coordinated with Events Team.
salesNotes: Simple activity-based fundraiser.

name: Fundraiser - Take It On
shortDescription: Laser Tag Challenge fundraiser.
details: Organization earns money for laser tag games played during fundraising night.
priceText: Organization earns $3 per laser tag game played.
customerFacingNotes: Registration coordinated with Events Team.
salesNotes: Good for youth groups, schools, teams, community organizations.

name: Fundraiser - Take It Over
shortDescription: Axe Throwing Challenge fundraiser.
details: Weeknight Axe Den fundraiser; axes, coaching and waivers are provided.
customerFacingNotes: Axe age and waiver rules apply.
salesNotes: Ask participant ages.

name: Private Event Room
shortDescription: Private room upgrade for birthdays and custom events.
details: Pricing depends on availability/use; site says no minimum time and no day/time up-charge; birthday parties receive a reduced rate.
customerFacingNotes: Rates depend on availability and use.
salesNotes: Do not quote a room rate unless configured later.

name: PlayCard Upgrade
shortDescription: Increase arcade PlayCard value for an event.
details: AdventurePlex promotes upgrading PlayCards as an event enhancement.
customerFacingNotes: Additional arcade value can be added.
salesNotes: Do not invent upgrade pricing.

name: Pre-Ordered Food / Tableside Delivery
shortDescription: Pre-order appetizers or entrees for event tableside delivery.
details: AdventurePlex promotes pre-ordering food as an event enhancement.
customerFacingNotes: Food options are available; exact menu and pricing should be confirmed.
salesNotes: Ask food/beverage interest on custom/group inquiries.

name: PourMyBeer Wall Tasting Experience
shortDescription: Self-pour craft beverage experience for adults.
details: AdventurePlex promotes a PourMyBeer Wall tasting experience for adults 21+.
customerFacingNotes: For guests 21+ with valid ID.
salesNotes: Only recommend for adult/21+ events; do not invent pricing/selection.

name: Birthday Party Deposit
shortDescription: Deposit policy for birthday parties.
details: Birthday party packages require a $100 deposit when booked.
customerFacingNotes: Birthday parties require a $100 deposit.
salesNotes: Do not confuse with large-group 25% deposit.

name: Large Group / Corporate Deposit
shortDescription: Deposit policy for large group and corporate events.
details: Large events/group reservations may pay in full or pay a 25% non-refundable deposit to reserve date/time.
priceText: 25% non-refundable deposit or payment in full.
customerFacingNotes: Large group/corporate events use a 25% non-refundable deposit unless paid in full.
salesNotes: Groups of 20+ should move into event inquiry/human finalization.

name: Birthday Outside Food / Dessert Policy
shortDescription: Outside-food exception for birthday packages.
details: Outside food/drinks generally prohibited. Birthday packages may bring cakes, cupcakes or cookies; frozen desserts can be stored until needed.
customerFacingNotes: Birthday desserts are allowed; other outside food/drink is not.
salesNotes: Differentiate from general outside-food policy.

name: General Outside Food & Drink Policy
shortDescription: Outside food and beverages are not permitted.
details: AdventurePlex says outside food/beverages are not allowed and notes vegetarian and gluten-free options are available.
customerFacingNotes: Outside food/drink is not allowed except the published birthday dessert exception.
salesNotes: For dietary needs, offer menu/staff confirmation rather than inventing details.

name: AdventurePlex Regular Operating Hours
shortDescription: Regular public opening hours for AdventurePlex.
details:
Regular public opening hours:
Monday: Closed for private events
Tuesday: 3:00 PM–9:00 PM
Wednesday: 3:00 PM–9:00 PM
Thursday: 3:00 PM–9:00 PM
Friday: 12:00 PM–10:00 PM
Saturday: 11:00 AM–10:00 PM
Sunday: 12:00 PM–8:00 PM
These are regular operating hours. Special events, holidays, private events, or temporary changes may affect hours. Regular hours do not confirm that a specific attraction or event is available.
customerFacingNotes: Quote these as regular AdventurePlex hours only. They are not live availability.
salesNotes: Do not apply these hours to another destination. If the asked destination has no published hours, say confirmed hours are not available.

name: AdventurePlex Minor Entry Policy
shortDescription: Guardian rule for guests under 16.
details: Guests must be 16+ to enter without a guardian. Under-16 guests need a guardian age 21+; each guardian may bring no more than 6 underage persons.
customerFacingNotes: Under-16 guests require a 21+ guardian; one guardian may accompany up to 6 underage guests.
salesNotes: Relevant for youth outings and general admission questions.

name: Reservation Rules
shortDescription: Rules for individual attraction reservations and larger groups.
details: Online reservations cover bowling, axe throwing and party packages. Axe online limits: 1-4 people/reservation. Bowling: 1-6 per lane reservation. Same-day by phone. Groups 20+ contact events team.
customerFacingNotes: Walk-ins are welcome when space is available; Saturday after 5pm is listed as a peak time.
salesNotes: Never claim live availability; collect requested date/time and hand off as needed.

name: Event Types We Host
shortDescription: Examples of events Generations markets and supports.
details: Birthday parties, group events, corporate events, holiday parties, sports/team events, weddings/receptions, custom events, graduations/summer celebrations, fundraisers, and Play Therapy/team-building.
customerFacingNotes: Custom events can be built when a fixed package is not the right fit.
salesNotes: Classify occasion early and use it to drive qualification.

name: AdventurePlex Contact & Location

customerFacingNotes: Use for human follow-up or same-day reservation guidance.

shortDescription: Published Raceway activities: go-kart racing, Putt Mania, and Game Zone.
details: Generations Raceway currently publishes go-kart racing, Putt Mania mini golf, and Game Zone arcade as on-site activities for kids and families. Go-kart racing is listed for ages 8 and up. Specific age or height eligibility for Putt Mania and Game Zone is not published in current knowledge.
customerFacingNotes: Use for kids, family, and activity questions. Do not invent unpublished age or height rules.
